quote: Codelco successfully secured US$600 million in climate financing from The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited (HSBC) and Banco Santander, guaranteed by the Multilateral Investment Guarantee Agency (MIGA) of the World Bank Group, for the complete decarbonization of its energy matrix.
note: Opened Codelco primary 2026-10-04; USD 600m HSBC/Santander / MIGA guarantee / renewable matrix to 2030 / prior USD 532m 2024 tranche mentioned confirmed.
